id: title:Gilbert09:implement the aws inspector import source

review.posthog_relevance: Adds AWS Inspector as a supported warehouse ingestion source, including client implementation, credential handling, pagination, and tests.
review.reason: The change implements AWS Inspector support across configuration, metadata, client implementation, and tests. This establishes a new warehouse ingestion capability, not just metadata. Tier 2 is assigned because the implementation and relevant checks are visible, though tier 3 requires broader systemic demonstration.
review.uncertainty: Tier 3 requires broader systemic demonstration; tier 1 is too low for a new warehouse ingestion capability.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed; score and confidence withheld.

observations.behavior: Adds AWS Inspector as a supported warehouse ingestion source.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds AWS Inspector to the supported warehouse sources metadata, indicating PostHog can ingest AWS Inspector findings and coverage data.

observations.behavior: Removes AWS Inspector from a list of unsupported or excluded AWS services.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes AWS Inspector from an exclusion list, consistent with its addition as a supported source.

observations.behavior: Implements the AWS Inspector client, request handling, pagination, credential validation, and row normalization.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides the backend implementation for fetching AWS Inspector data, including authentication, error handling, and pagination, enabling PostHog warehouse ingestion of Inspector findings and coverage.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the AWS Inspector API calls, credential handling, or the actual data ingestion and warehouse loading. It only adds configuration, metadata, and the source registration. Without the execution and warehouse-side changes, the tier cannot be established.

observations.behavior: Adds AWS Inspector connector metadata, endpoint definitions, and credential error messages.
observations.posthog_connection: Defines AWS Inspector API endpoints and metadata for warehouse ingestion, including pagination and incremental fields.

observations.behavior: Changes the source class to support resumption and adds credential validation, schema building, and configuration.
observations.posthog_connection: Registers AWS Inspector as a warehouse source, supporting incremental ingestion and credential checks.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are available; no other hunks, PR metadata, or release notes are provided. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds AWS Inspector credential and region fields to AwsInspectorSourceConfig; P1.F6.H1 adds comprehensive pytest-backed tests for pagination, incremental filtering, resume, credential validation, error handling and regional signing.
observations.posthog_connection: These fields are required to authenticate AWS Inspector API calls; P1.F6.H1 demonstrates that the connector can request, paginate, resume and safely redact credentials while handling AWS-specific error shapes and pagination tokens.
